Our story

Just a potato? think again..

That's what they all said. Until one decided to get a little… POTASTIC.

Inspired by Istanbul's street-side kumpir and raised on desi spice, every bowl starts with a fat, oven-baked spud. We split it, fluff it with butter and cheese, then pile on the drama — jalapeños, sweet corn, a crunchy spiced crumble, and sauces that don't know when to stop.

The potato stayed the same. The standards did not.

01

Start with a big one.

A fat, fluffy potato baked low and slow till the skin crackles and the inside turns to cloud.

02

Split. Fluff. Melt.

Cracked open and mashed right in the skin with butter and cheese — the kumpir way.

03

Sweet corn shower.

Buttery kernels go in by the handful. Little pops of sweet against all that savoury.

04

Jalapeño jolt.

Pickled jalapeño coins for heat and tang. Brave hearts can ask for extra.

05

The crunch.

Our spiced red crumble — the bit of Indian drama that makes people come back the next day.

06

Drizzle. Dialed up to a 10.

Molten cheese sauce, a ketchup swirl and a pinch of herbs. Same potato. A whole new experience.

Potastic!
